en: A black and white image depicting a waterfront village with traditional Scandinavian-style buildings along the shore. In the foreground, several pavilion-like structures with pointed roofs are visible by the water's edge. The background shows rocky, sparsely vegetated terrain and several boats on the water. The top left of the postcard has the printed text 'Östersidan. Fiskebäckskil.'
